_note: Curated BUILT-IN PastCast events. Read-only in the app; a user's own events live in %LocalAppData%\Anvil\SavedEvents.json. Every start is UTC on a 5-minute mark, every window is one of 30/60/120/180/360/720 minutes, and every leg must pass tools/check_saved_events.py (the archive really holds volumes for that site and window). Each event names its source for the times.
